request.style: English, Female solo voice, warm and resonant, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, light percussion, hopeful and contemplative mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We did not receive a spirit of slavery
To fall back into the old fear
But the Spirit of adoption is our guide
Crying out in a new way

[Verse]
He testifies with our own spirit
That we are God's dear children
And if children then we are heirs
Co-heirs with Christ the King

[Chorus]
Sufferings of this present time
Are not worth comparing
With the glory that is to be
Revealed in us all

[Verse]
Creation waits with eager longing
For the revealing of sons and daughters
Subjected to futility not by choice
But by the one who set it

[Chorus]
Sufferings of this present time
Are not worth comparing
With the glory that is to be
Revealed in us all

[Bridge]
In hope it was subjected
So that creation might be free
Set free from its bondage to decay
Into the freedom of glory

[Outro]
Freedom of the glory of God's children
Revealed in us all
